roles.GENERATOR_AUTHORITY: may create truth, observables, corruption plan and raw synthetic files
roles.PIPELINE_AUTHORITY: may read observables/raw files only; may not read truth, generator internals, hidden labels or seed-specific answer keys
roles.FINAL_AUDIT_AUTHORITY: opens truth only after ETL, network/program selection, checkpoint selection and reporting are frozen

forbidden_to_pipeline: true causal perturbation targets/effects beyond observable experimental design
truth labels for biology vs technical confound
true donor/source leakage labels for checkpoints
generator random seeds if they permit reconstruction of truth
allowed_observables: ordinary metadata fields permitted by the corresponding real-data contract
dataset/source/operator descriptors prospectively lawful for ETL
public structural schema and acquisition manifests
challenge version and observable seed-independent format description
filesystem_rule: Truth root must be physically disjoint from pipeline input roots. Pipeline preflight must reject truth-like filenames/paths if discovered under an input root.
violation_policy: Any truth exposure before the relevant freeze invalidates that challenge version for claims of blind qualification. Preserve the failure and regenerate a new challenge version/seed family.
